purchase_objections: Your hero beat is 'Accept all' — that is exactly how I'd miss something; show me reviewing, not bulk-accepting.
After '10 of 10 reviewed' the memo table still says €71–73m and a teammate's assistant proposes the same fix — so did it actually catch everything?
The chatbot is a strawman: 'Regenerating all 12 slides… about 5 min left' to change one number is not what Copilot in PowerPoint does for me today.
'Your files, stored on your device' sits next to 'Cloud AI may process document content' — my compliance team will ask which provider sees client data.
Does it open my existing files from SharePoint/Drive and keep my firm's templates, or do I migrate into a new app?
Evidence panel is from a lender-deck demo and the teammate is simulated; I'm seeing a staged demo, not a workflow like mine.
Early access only, no price or integration info.
would_try: maybe — the cell/sentence/slide-element diff list with 'Revenue!E6 8.9 → 8.5' and 'Slide 4 title €71–73m → €74.6m' is the first AI-for-Office thing I've seen that looks auditable, but I'd want it on my own files before trusting it.
buy_decision: TRY_FIRST — flips to BUY if I see it on a real messy pack (linked charts, my template, a footnote) with each change reviewed one by one and a clear statement of which cloud model processes the content.
